name: Backstory
html:
Knowledge Algorithms grew out of Energy Algorithms, which focused on energy trading related tools and data analytics. I realized that the same approach I successfully used in the most volatile market in the world can be applied to decision making and knowlege building across multiple industries.

This is frankly what I love to do in my free time - think about different ways to organize data, extract meaning from it, and present it visually.

The outcome I aim for: confidence of knowing that you can get insight from all parts of your data stack, whatever the world throws at you.
